{{Quote|We've repositioned ourselves near a portion of their army. We're going to strengthen our forces and wipe them out.|Qui-Gon Jinn, to the Wookiees at the base, in reference to the Trade Federation outpost|audio=BaseQuote5th.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
A '''base''' was built by [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] close in proximity to a [[Trade Federation outpost]]. The base had access to several vital resources, including [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]], [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]], and [[Ore/Legends|ore]]. The layout of the base was initially composed of a [[command center]], three [[prefab shelter]]s, and an [[animal nursery]], and was expanded to include several resource storage and military buildings. One of these buildings was a [[Shipyard (water)|shipyard]] on the bank of a nearby [[Water/Legends|river]], where several [[Transport Ship (Wookiee)|transport ships]] were built and used to launch an [[Attack on the Trade Federation outpost|attack]] on the [[Trade Federation]] outpost.

==Description==
{{Quote|First, have your workers build a shipyard by the water's edge.|Qui-Gon Jinn, to Chewbacca|audio=Shipyard.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Shipyard_Wookiee.png|thumb|left|260px|The base's shipyard shortly after its construction]]
The base was one of several constructed by workers of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]]. The initial layout of the base included a central [[command center]] with a line of [[Tree/Legends|trees]] on its north-facing sides, an [[animal nursery]] near the command center, and three [[prefab shelter]]s. The base was expanded to include<ref name="GB" /> enough prefab shelters to house at least twenty-nine Wookiees,<ref name="Prima" /> a [[food processing center]], a [[carbon processing center]], a [[nova processing center]], an [[ore processing center]], multiple [[Farm/Legends|farms]] and [[Barracks/Legends|troop centers]], a [[Factory/Legends|mech factory]], and an [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] [[Shipyard (water)|shipyard]] on the river on the western side of the base. At least one [[Power core/Legends|power core]] supplied energy to the buildings, and at least one [[Sentry tower/Legends|sentry post]] was built in the wide open space to the north of the base. The immediate vicinity of the base featured several important resources; [[Muja fruit/Legends|muja fruit]] [[Bush/Legends|bushes]] and [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]] animals, and small [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystal]] and [[Ore/Legends|ore]] deposits.<ref name="GB" />

==History==
{{Quote|You should create a food processing center near your muja fruit bushes.|Qui-Gon Jinn to the Wookiees|audio=MeWantFood.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The base was built<ref name="GB" /> between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]]<ref name="NEC" /> during a [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]] between Wookiee [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]] and the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] for the right to [[Colonist/Legends|colonize]] Alaris Prime. The location was chosen for its proximity to a [[Trade Federation outpost]], which the Wookiee leader [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] planned to [[Attack on the Trade Federation outpost|destroy]]. Chewbacca and two Wookiee workers were present at the base for the initial preparations, with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], an [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] to the Wookiees, asking them to recruit twelve more workers to the base.<ref name="GB" /> One worker built a power core to the north of the command center while another constructed prefab shelters to support the arriving workers.<ref name="Prima" /> The nerfs near the base were also herded into the animal nursery.<ref name="GB" />

[[File:Ship_base_troop.jpg|thumb|right|280px|A troop center at the base, with two bowcaster troopers]]
As more workers arrived and began gathering [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] from [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] [[Plant/Legends|bushes]], Jinn recommended the construction of a processing center to store food more efficiently and to support the creation of farms within the base. The next buildings to be added were a [[Troop/Legends|troop]] center, where two Wookiees were trained as [[bowcaster trooper]]s to protect the base while Chewbacca explored the surrounding area, and a shipyard, from which a [[utility trawler]] was built to [[Fishing/Legends|gather]] [[Fish/Legends|fish]] from the river. A sentry post was then built north of the base, and Jinn recommended that centers for storing [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]]&mdash;which could be gathered from trees, nova [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]], and ore&mdash;be constructed.<ref name="GB" />

In order to gather additional food, an [[AquaHarvester]] was built on the river by the utility [[Trawler/Legends|trawler]]. After the base's [[technology level]] had been sufficiently improved, Jinn had the Wookiees build a mech factory, which allowed for two [[HummBike]] [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeders]] to be assembled. Two Wookiees rode these [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]] to explore the open space north of the settlement and found no trace of the Trade Federation outpost, leading Jinn to determine it was on the other side of the river. At the shipyard, a [[Transport Ship (Wookiee)|transport ship]] was built, which the speeder [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] boarded and traveled across the river to explore the other side. When the outpost was located there, Jinn asked the Wookiees to gather an [[Army/Legends|army]] of twelve Wookiees.<ref name="GB" /> This force included Chewbacca, several [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcaster]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], [[dragon trooper]]s, and [[Thermal detonator trooper (Wookiee)|grenade troopers]], as well as a [[Wookiee medical droid]] built at the command center.<ref name="Prima" /> The Wookiees built a second troop center to train the fighting Wookiees more efficiently and created enough [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ships to cross the river. Once all were ready, Chewbacca and his forces destroyed the outpost.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Build some more troops at your troop center. You'll need a dozen or more troopers to succeed.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=TroopCenter.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The base was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' by [[Steven L. Kent]],<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>&mdash;released on [[November 7]], [[2001]]<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref>&mdash;before appearing in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="GB" /> released on [[November 11]], 2001.<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> It as the center of operations for the player in the fifth level of the tutorial campaign, entitled "Exploration and Transport." At the start of the level, the base only has the five buildings and the player has to acquire the resources to create more buildings following Jinn's recommendations.<ref name="GB" />

The strategy guide has several differences concerning the base when compared<ref name="Prima" /> to the finished game. At the beginning of the level, Jinn recommends creating twelve workers,<ref name="GB" /> whereas the guide states that nine will be sufficient. The guide also recommends attacking the Trade Federation with an army of fifteen,<ref name="Prima" /> while in-game Jinn suggests at least twelve.<ref name="GB" /> This article assumes the game's portrayal of events to be correct.
